extras: The plugin supports three installation methods: standard install, using BRAT, or manual file placement.
intentEvidence: Add variables in Templates and set their values on-the-fly during the Note creation.
problem: Standard templates lack a mechanism to dynamically prompt the user for specific data when a new note is generated from a template.

relations.evidence: Assigning Templates to Notes can be done using plugins like Daily notes or Templater.
If you insert a template into an existing Note (e.g. via Templater), you can open the Command Palette and find the Varinote: command.

summary: Varinode allows users to define variables within Obsidian templates and set their values dynamically through a modal interface when creating a new note.
